title: Strange Printer II
sourceKind: official-page-blocked; statement and examples from WebSearch result summaries citing leetcode.com/problems/strange-printer-ii, leetcode.doocs.org/en/lc/1591/, algo.monster/liteproblems/1591
summary: Given an m x n targetGrid of colors, a printer paints one solid rectangle of a single color per turn, overwriting what is under it. Each color may be used only once. Return true if the grid can be printed.
officialConstraints: 1 <= m, n <= 60; each color is between 1 and 60.
visualizationNotes: Visualization caps the grid at 12 x 12 and distinct colors at 24 (GraphTraversalView limits).
